user.title: Choose MeshCore channel
user.description: Select a channel configured in the MeshCore integration. Its message entity and channel index are detected automatically.

participant.title: Choose participant
participant.description: Detected in the activity history of the chosen channel: {participants}. You can also enter a name if no GPS message exists yet.

person.title: Choose person
person.description: Select the person this tracker is intended for. After setup, add the generated tracker to this person once in Home Assistant settings.

confirm.title: Check configuration

abort.no_channels: No loaded MeshCore channels were found. Check that the MeshCore integration is connected and has configured channels.
abort.already_configured: This participant is already configured for this channel entity.
